CARD DESIGNS

1. Clay Pit (clay-pit): Age I brown card, one copy, from 3 players. Cost: 1 coin.
   - Produces 1 unit of your choice of clay or ore every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

2. Clay Pool (clay-pool): Age I brown card, two copies, from 3 and 5 players. Cost: free.
   - Produces 1 clay every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

3. Excavation (excavation): Age I brown card, one copy, from 4 players. Cost: 1 coin.
   - Produces 1 unit of your choice of clay or stone every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

4. Forest Cave (forest-cave): Age I brown card, one copy, from 5 players. Cost: 1 coin.
   - Produces 1 unit of your choice of wood or ore every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

5. Lumber Yard (lumber-yard): Age I brown card, two copies, from 3 and 4 players. Cost: free.
   - Produces 1 wood every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

6. Mine (mine): Age I brown card, one copy, from 6 players. Cost: 1 coin.
   - Produces 1 unit of your choice of stone or ore every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

7. Ore Vein (ore-vein): Age I brown card, two copies, from 3 and 4 players. Cost: free.
   - Produces 1 ore every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

8. Stone Pit (stone-pit): Age I brown card, two copies, from 3 and 5 players. Cost: free.
   - Produces 1 stone every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

9. Timber Yard (timber-yard): Age I brown card, one copy, from 3 players. Cost: 1 coin.
   - Produces 1 unit of your choice of wood or stone every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

10. Tree Farm (tree-farm): Age I brown card, one copy, from 6 players. Cost: 1 coin.
   - Produces 1 unit of your choice of wood or clay every turn. Neighbours may buy it.

11. Glassworks (glassworks-age-1): Age I grey card, two copies, from 3 and 6 players. Cost: free.
   - Produces 1 glass every turn. Neighbours may buy it.
   - Shares its name with the Age II Glassworks: a city that holds either may not construct the other.

12. Loom (loom-age-1): Age I grey card, two copies, from 3 and 6 players. Cost: free.
   - Produces 1 cloth every turn. Neighbours may buy it.
   - Shares its name with the Age II Loom: a city that holds either may not construct the other.

13. Press (press-age-1): Age I grey card, two copies, from 3 and 6 players. Cost: free.
   - Produces 1 papyrus every turn. Neighbours may buy it.
   - Shares its name with the Age II Press: a city that holds either may not construct the other.

14. Barracks (barracks): Age I red card, two copies, from 3 and 5 players. Cost: 1 ore.
   - 1 shield of military strength.

15. Guard Tower (guard-tower): Age I red card, two copies, from 3 and 4 players. Cost: 1 clay.
   - 1 shield of military strength.

16. Stockade (stockade): Age I red card, two copies, from 3 and 7 players. Cost: 1 wood.
   - 1 shield of military strength.

17. Altar (altar): Age I blue card, two copies, from 3 and 5 players. Cost: free.
   - Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Shows chain symbol 15, which makes Pantheon free to construct later.

18. Baths (baths): Age I blue card, two copies, from 3 and 7 players. Cost: 1 stone.
   - Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Shows chain symbol 3, which makes Aqueduct free to construct later.

19. Theater (theater): Age I blue card, two copies, from 3 and 6 players. Cost: free.
   - Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Shows chain symbol 14, which makes Gardens free to construct later.

20. Well (well): Age I blue card, two copies, from 4 and 7 players. Cost: free.
   - Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Shows chain symbol 5, which makes Statue free to construct later.

21. East Trading Post (east-trading-post): Age I yellow card, two copies, from 3 and 7 players. Cost: free.
   - You buy wood, clay, stone and ore from your right neighbour at 1 coin per unit instead of 2.
   - Shows chain symbol 7, which makes Forum free to construct later.

22. Marketplace (marketplace): Age I yellow card, two copies, from 3 and 6 players. Cost: free.
   - You buy glass, papyrus and cloth from either neighbour at 1 coin per unit instead of 2.
   - Shows chain symbol 6, which makes Caravansery free to construct later.

23. Tavern (tavern): Age I yellow card, three copies, from 4, 5 and 7 players. Cost: free.
   - You gain 5 coins once, when it is placed.

24. West Trading Post (west-trading-post): Age I yellow card, two copies, from 3 and 7 players. Cost: free.
   - You buy wood, clay, stone and ore from your left neighbour at 1 coin per unit instead of 2.
   - Shows chain symbol 7, which makes Forum free to construct later.

   - Shows chain symbol 2, which makes Stables free to construct later.
   - Shows chain symbol 8, which makes Dispensary free to construct later.

   - Once, when placed: you gain 3 coins for each wonder stage built in your city.
   - At the end of the game: worth 1 victory point for each wonder stage built in your city.
   - Free to construct if you already own Dispensary, which shows chain symbol 17.

71. Builders Guild (builders-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 2 clay, 3 stone and 1 glass.
   - At the end of the game: worth 1 victory point for each wonder stage built in your city and your two neighbours' cities.

72. Craftsmens Guild (craftsmens-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 2 stone and 2 ore.
   - At the end of the game: worth 2 victory points for each grey card in your two neighbours' cities.

73. Decorators Guild (decorators-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 1 stone, 2 ore and 1 cloth.
   - At the end of the game: worth 7 victory points if every stage of your wonder side is built.

74. Magistrates Guild (magistrates-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 3 wood, 1 stone and 1 cloth.
   - At the end of the game: worth 1 victory point for each blue card in your two neighbours' cities.

75. Philosophers Guild (philosophers-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 3 clay, 1 papyrus and 1 cloth.
   - At the end of the game: worth 1 victory point for each green card in your two neighbours' cities.

76. Scientists Guild (scientists-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 2 wood, 2 ore and 1 papyrus.
   - Counts as one science symbol of your choice (compass, gear or tablet), chosen when the game is scored.

77. Shipowners Guild (shipowners-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 3 wood, 1 glass and 1 papyrus.
   - At the end of the game: worth 1 victory point for each brown, each grey and each purple card in your city, this card included.

78. Spies Guild (spies-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 2 clay and 1 glass.
   - At the end of the game: worth 1 victory point for each red card in your two neighbours' cities.

79. Traders Guild (traders-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 1 glass, 1 papyrus and 1 cloth.
   - At the end of the game: worth 1 victory point for each yellow card in your two neighbours' cities.

80. Workers Guild (workers-guild): Age III purple guild (N + 2 of the 10 guilds are drawn for N players). Cost: 1 wood, 1 clay, 1 stone and 2 ore.
   - At the end of the game: worth 1 victory point for each brown card in your two neighbours' cities.

WONDER BOARDS

1. Alexandria, the Lighthouse (alexandria). Produces 1 glass every turn from the start, which neighbours may buy.
   - Day side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 stone. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Day side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 2 ore. Produces 1 unit of your choice of wood, clay, stone or ore every turn. Neighbours may not buy it.
   - Day side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 1 papyrus and 1 cloth. Worth 7 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 clay. Produces 1 unit of your choice of wood, clay, stone or ore every turn. Neighbours may not buy it.
   - Night side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 3 ore. Produces 1 unit of your choice of glass, papyrus or cloth every turn. Neighbours may not buy it.
   - Night side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 4 wood. Worth 7 victory points at the end of the game.

2. Babylon, the Hanging Gardens (babylon). Produces 1 wood every turn from the start, which neighbours may buy.
   - Day side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 clay. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Day side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 2 ore and 1 cloth. Counts as one science symbol of your choice (compass, gear or tablet), chosen when the game is scored.
   - Day side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 4 wood. Worth 7 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 1 of 2. Cost: 2 stone. From this Age on, you keep the card left over on the sixth turn and play it as an extra turn after everyone's sixth card.
   - Night side, stage 2 of 2. Cost: 3 clay and 1 glass. Counts as one science symbol of your choice (compass, gear or tablet), chosen when the game is scored.

3. Ephesos, the Temple of Artemis (ephesos). Produces 1 papyrus every turn from the start, which neighbours may buy.
   - Day side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 clay. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Day side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 2 wood. You gain 9 coins once, when it is placed.
   - Day side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 2 ore and 1 glass. Worth 7 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 stone. You gain 4 coins once, when it is placed. Worth 2 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 2 wood. You gain 4 coins once, when it is placed. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 2 ore and 1 cloth. You gain 4 coins once, when it is placed. Worth 5 victory points at the end of the game.

4. Gizah, the Pyramids (gizah). Produces 1 stone every turn from the start, which neighbours may buy.
   - Day side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 wood. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Day side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 2 clay and 1 cloth. Worth 5 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Day side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 4 stone. Worth 7 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 1 of 4. Cost: 2 wood. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 2 of 4. Cost: 3 stone. Worth 5 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 3 of 4. Cost: 3 clay. Worth 5 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 4 of 4. Cost: 4 stone and 1 papyrus. Worth 7 victory points at the end of the game.

5. Halikarnassos, the Mausoleum (halikarnassos). Produces 1 cloth every turn from the start, which neighbours may buy.
   - Day side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 ore. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Day side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 1 glass and 1 papyrus. At the end of the turn this stage is built, you look through the discard pile and may construct one card from it for free.
   - Day side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 3 stone. Worth 7 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 clay. At the end of the turn this stage is built, you look through the discard pile and may construct one card from it for free. Worth 2 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 1 glass and 1 papyrus. At the end of the turn this stage is built, you look through the discard pile and may construct one card from it for free. Worth 1 victory point at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 3 wood. At the end of the turn this stage is built, you look through the discard pile and may construct one card from it for free.

6. Olympia, the Statue of Zeus (olympia). Produces 1 clay every turn from the start, which neighbours may buy.
   - Day side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 stone. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Day side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 2 wood. Constructing a building of a colour not yet in your city is free.
   - Day side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 3 clay. Worth 7 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 ore. The building you construct on the first turn of each Age is free. Worth 2 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 3 clay. The building you construct on the sixth turn of each Age is free. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 1 glass, 1 papyrus and 1 cloth. Worth 5 victory points at the end of the game.

7. Rhodos, the Colossus (rhodos). Produces 1 ore every turn from the start, which neighbours may buy.
   - Day side, stage 1 of 3. Cost: 2 wood. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Day side, stage 2 of 3. Cost: 3 clay. 2 shields of military strength.
   - Day side, stage 3 of 3. Cost: 4 ore. Worth 7 victory points at the end of the game.
   - Night side, stage 1 of 2. Cost: 3 stone. You gain 3 coins once, when it is placed. Worth 3 victory points at the end of the game. 1 shield of military strength.
   - Night side, stage 2 of 2. Cost: 4 ore. You gain 4 coins once, when it is placed. Worth 4 victory points at the end of the game. 1 shield of military strength.
